record.question: Find the perpendicular distance of the line 3y = 4x + 5 from (2,1)
record.explanation: Rewriting 3y = 4x + 5 as 4x - 3y + 5 = 0, the distance from (2, 1) is |8 - 3 + 5| / sqrt(16 + 9) = 10 / 5 = 2, which is option (b).
